description:
Ethereum mainnet on-chain read: the latest block number. Returns the latest Ethereum mainnet block number via eth_blockNumber. Takes no parameters.

GET https://api.arysphere.com/v1/ventures/x402_eth_reads_v1/eth_mainnet_eth_blocknumber. Same payment terms as that HTTP route.
Call once with no payment. The result is the payment terms. Retry the same call with the signed payment at _meta["x402/payment"].
Measured output: {"chain": "ethereum", "hex": "0x18ff378", "method": "eth_blockNumber", "ok": true, "result": 26211192, "service": "x402_eth_reads_v1.eth_mainnet_eth_blocknumber"}
name: x402_eth_reads_v1__eth_mainnet_eth_blocknumber
